race.comment: AWESOME FORCE (9) has been flying home his past couple, including over 2100m here last time out as the race favourite. Likely to get back again from the wide draw, but the extra 100m should suit. Can storm over the top to get the job done this time around. ETERNAL ROMANCE (4) won two back at Northam over the mile before a 3.5L defeat in Saturday grade over 2100m here. Faithfull hops back on board today and she did pull up with a slight issue last time out. Expecting a much better effort this time around. DANDY'S GEM (11) sprinted quickly to get the job done here last week, scoring over 2100m to score by a head. That was a good return to form and there's no reason why she can't go on with the job. SISTER MARY (7) hasn't been far away her past couple after a good win three back. Can be flying late in the race. ARGYLE STAR (2) gets Pike on board now out in trip and she can improve again.
